headline: 6 months on, U.S. Navy families who evacuated Bahrain remain in limbo
context: When the U.S.-Iran war began, more than 1,000 dependents of U.S. Navy personnel in Bahrain were ordered to evacuate. After six months in temporary conditions, they want to know what the plan is.
